headline: 3 core Solana programs catalogued (Unstake, Router, Reserve Pool); Solana base58 addresses are incompatible with the 0x schema — recorded in evidence and unknowns for next run.
short_headline: 3 programs found; Solana addr format gap

findings.text: D1: Solana has no Etherscan-style name-tag search API. Searched SolanaFM substack article and solanacompass.com for Sanctum program addresses; SolanaFM article (Aug 2023) lists 3 tagged on-chain addresses: Sanctum Unstake Program (unpXTU2Ndrc7WWNyEhQWe4udTzSibLPi25SXv2xbCHQ), Sanctum Router Program (stkitrT1Uoy18Dk1fTrgPw8W6MVzoCfYoAFT4MLsmhq), Sanctum SOL Reserve Pool (3rBnnH9TTgd3xwu48rnzGsaQkSr1hR64nY71DrDt6VrQ).

D2: Sanctum docs at learn.sanctum.so/docs list a 'Deployed programs' section in the nav (confirmed from docs landing page fetch). The URL learn.sanctum.so/docs/for-developers/deployed-programs was attempted but rejected by the fetch allowlist (not previously surfaced). Set deployed_contracts_doc to the docs root; the specific deployments page remains unfetched this run.

D3: Audit PDF linked at https://github.com/igneous-labs/sanctum-unstake-program/blob/master/audits/sec3-20230724.pdf confirmed present (GitHub page fetched). PDF viewer URL encodes commit b6db89b0d39e8ff798171331dd6f8d120dbc9327. PDF binary not parsed this run — no in-scope address table extracted. Recorded as unknowns D3 entry.

D4: GitHub org igneous-labs has 97 repos. Key repos: sanctum-unstake-program (Reserve/Unstake program, mainnet deploy commit 11aac05b22794e6c2c3366dbb7141f4c61845c24), S/inf-1.5 (Infinity pool), sanctum-lst-list, sanctum-router-sdk, sanctum-router-jup-interface. No broadcast/run-latest.json or deployments.json found in fetched pages; Anchor.toml present in sanctum-unstake-program but not fetched.

D5: Protocol is Solana-only (single chain). No multi-chain enumeration required. Solana has no EVM block explorer; DeFiPunkd read API does not support Solana (chainId not in supported list). All on-chain reads blocked by infrastructure mismatch.

D6: Sanctum Reserve Pool (3rBnnH9TTgd3xwu48rnzGsaQkSr1hR64nY71DrDt6VrQ) is a single SOL liquidity pool account managed by the Unstake program, not a factory with enumerable children. Router Program (stkitrT1Uoy18Dk1fTrgPw8W6MVzoCfYoAFT4MLsmhq) routes across 1000+ LST pools but the factory pattern does not apply here. No factory-child enumeration applicable.

D7: Role taxonomy applied to discovered addresses: Sanctum Unstake Program = 'other' (on-chain program / program ID, Solana native); Sanctum Router Program = 'router'; Sanctum SOL Reserve Pool = 'pool' (SOL liquidity reserve). All actor_class = 'unknown' as bytecode/upgrade-authority not read this run. CLOUD governance token and voting contracts not yet address-confirmed.

D8: All discovered addresses are Solana base58 program IDs (32-byte, not EVM 0x format). Schema requires admin_addresses[].address to match ^0x[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$. Addresses cannot be placed in admin_addresses[]; recorded in evidence[] shows fields and unknowns[] for next-run inheritance. This is a systematic gap for Solana-native protocols under the current schema.

rationale.verdict: Discovery run completed. Three core program addresses surfaced from a 2023 SolanaFM analysis article and confirmed via GitHub README (mainnet deploy commit). Docs nav confirms a 'Deployed programs' page exists but the specific URL was blocked by the fetch allowlist. DeFiPunkd read API does not support Solana chainId, so zero on-chain reads via the API were possible. All Solana base58 addresses are incompatible with the schema's 0x address constraint and are recorded in evidence/unknowns for the next run. Grade is unknown per discovery slice rules.

protocol_metadata.about: Sanctum is Solana's leading liquid staking infrastructure, allowing users to instantly unstake any of 1,361+ liquid staking tokens (LSTs) by drawing on a shared SOL Reserve Pool. The Sanctum Unstake Program controls the Reserve Pool and handles instant redemptions for a small fee, while the Sanctum Router Program routes LST-to-LST swaps via cross-program invocations across stake pools without users handling raw stake accounts. Sanctum also offers staking-as-a-service (custom branded LSTs and validators for institutions) and transaction delivery infrastructure (Gateway). The protocol is governed via MetaDAO futarchy-style decision markets using the CLOUD (proposed rename: SANC) token.
